description: TRUSTTRACE Verified Dataset Source and Class Taxonomy Mapping Specification

REAL.forensic_definition: Authentic, unmanipulated optical camera photographs and scans preserving natural sensor noise, valid EXIF provenance, and uniform compression.

EDITED.forensic_definition: Digital images containing localized spatial modifications, copy-move cloning, splicing, retouching, or multi-cycle compression anomalies.

AI-GENERATED.forensic_definition: Synthetic visual assets generated by diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, DALL-E, Imagen) or Generative Adversarial Networks (StyleGAN, ProGAN).

SCREENSHOT-MANIPULATED.forensic_definition: Digital screenshot assets exhibiting localized interface tampering, font kerning/baseline anomalies, synthetic text overlays, or manipulated transaction records.
SCREENSHOT-MANIPULATED.policy_note: A normal unaltered screenshot is NOT automatically SCREENSHOT-MANIPULATED. Legitimate screenshots must only enter this class if documented localized modifications were applied.

unmapped_policy.rationale: Images from undocumented or ambiguous sources cannot be assigned to forensic classes without cryptographic or experimental provenance verification.
